# Exit condition

`customer_support.pb.escalation_management.exit_condition` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> State the de-escalation condition at the moment of handoff, not later. Write down what would make this an ordinary ticket again.

An exit condition authored at the start is a description of the problem; authored at the end it is a justification for closing the flag. Only the first one is useful, and only the first one keeps the escalated pool honest.
